# Reading interval

This example uses synthetic wording and fictional reviewers.
The extra paragraphs make it possible to test reading position at different screen widths.

Author focus changes only the display.
Every stored decision and attribution remains available.

Returning to All authors restores the complete redline.
The Original and Proposed readings remain available in every author selection.

:::: {.review-thread #c1 by=R}
Compare both revisions in this passage.
::: {.reply #reply1 by=A}
Both suggestions remain pending.
:::
::::
